BiblicalUsage: Bilshan means in slander, and he is named twice, both times in the same list. Ezra 2:2 counts him among the men who came up with Zerubbabel, and Nehemiah 7:7 counts him again in the same return. A man who came home from exile, named in two copies of one list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bilshan's double listing is the return in miniature: the same names, counted twice, because coming home mattered enough to record twice.
